fusions.name: Trawl Fling
fusions.desc: Flings a heavy mesh that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second. It has a 50% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Cinch Sweep
fusions.desc: Rakes a cone ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 35% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds. You have 4 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Haul Line
fusions.desc: Drops a line of netting 6 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Tight Mesh
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour is 12% higher.
